metadata.name: Authentication & Authorization Core Infrastructure
metadata.description: Complete authentication and authorization system controlling user access, preventing unauthorized document access, and maintaining security perimeter.

purpose.overview: MailMyPDF processes sensitive personal documents. Authentication verifies users are who they claim to be. Authorization ensures users can only access their own documents and workflows.
principles: Zero Trust: Never trust, always verify
Least Privilege: Users have minimum necessary permissions
Defense in Depth: Multiple layers of security

methods.name: email-password
methods.implementation: Password hashed with bcrypt (cost factor 12+), never stored in plaintext
requirements: Complexity: uppercase + lowercase + numbers + special chars
Rate limiting: max 5 failed attempts per 15 minutes
Account lockout: 30 minutes after 5 failed attempts

methods.name: oauth2-google
methods.implementation: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow with PKCE
methods.benefits: No password management, MFA via Google

methods.name: oauth2-microsoft
methods.implementation: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow with PKCE

methods.name: mfa-totp
methods.implementation: RFC 6238 TOTP with 30-second window and 6-digit codes
methods.requirements: Mandatory for users with sensitive documents; optional for others
methods.backup: 10 single-use backup codes provided during MFA setup

sessionToken.algorithm: JWT (JSON Web Token) with HS256 or RS256 signature

storage.client: Secure HTTPOnly cookie (cannot be accessed via JavaScript)

sessionManagement.validation: Verify signature and expiration on every request

passwordPolicy.complexity: Must contain: uppercase, lowercase, number, special character
passwordPolicy.expiration: Every 90 days; user notified 14 days before expiry
passwordPolicy.resetRequired: After first login, after password reset
passwordPolicy.breachCheck: Compare against HaveIBeenPwned database on change

rbac.description: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Users assigned roles; roles have permissions

roles.name: document_processor
roles.limitation: Can only access documents they upload or are explicitly shared

roles.name: support_agent
roles.limitation: Cannot delete or permanently modify documents; session recorded

roles.name: guest
roles.limitation: One-time use; documents auto-deleted after 24 hours

dataOwnership.principle: Users own their documents; cannot access others' unless explicitly shared
dataOwnership.enforcement: Every document query filtered by owner_id AND user's access permissions

sharing.method: Explicit share via link with access control
controls: Audit logging of all views by shared users

apiKey.storage: Only hash stored; user can view full key once on creation
restrictions: Scope limitation (cannot grant more permissions than user has)

teamSharing.workspaces: Teams can create shared workspaces for multi-user access

requirements.name: authentication-bypass
requirements.test: Verify cannot access protected resources without valid credentials
requirements.method: Attempt API calls without token; verify 401 Unauthorized returned

requirements.name: authorization-bypass
requirements.test: Verify User A cannot access User B's documents
requirements.method: User A attempts to fetch User B's document ID; verify 403 Forbidden

requirements.name: token-forgery
requirements.test: Verify cannot forge or tamper with JWT tokens
requirements.method: Attempt to modify JWT payload; verify signature validation fails

requirements.name: session-hijacking
requirements.test: Verify session tokens cannot be stolen/used by attackers
requirements.method: HTTPOnly cookie prevents JavaScript theft; Secure flag requires HTTPS

requirements.name: privilege-escalation
requirements.test: Verify users cannot escalate their own privileges
requirements.method: Attempt to add admin permission to own role; verify rejected

accountCompromise.detection: Multiple failed login attempts; unusual geographic access; API key misuse detected
response: Immediately invalidate all active sessions for affected user
Force password reset on next login
Notify user via email and SMS
Review audit logs for unauthorized actions
If sensitive documents were accessed, notify data subjects
Rotate all other API keys for affected user
Audit all calls made with exposed key

compliance.logging: All authentication/authorization events logged: login, logout, failed attempts, privilege changes

libraries: Cloud: AWS IAM, Google Cloud IAM, Auth0
implementation.deployment: Must be implemented before any user access
